# Polter

> Polter is a terminal for macOS and Windows, built on Ghostty, in which one Claude Code session supervises the coding agents running in your other tabs: it reads their screens, types into them, and is told how long each has been still.

Polter is not a sub-agent framework: workers are independent terminal sessions, and their output is written to disk line by line. It needs no account and sends nothing to the cloud; data lives under `$XDG_STATE_HOME/polter/`. It is not affiliated with the Ghostty project, with `steipete/poltergeist`, with Polter Finance, or with polter.io.
